strings.key_notice_to_director_of_immigration: 12. strings.key_employer_pay_transport_costs_on_deat: 14. In the event of the death of the Helper, the Employer shall pay the cost of transporting the Helper's remains and personal property from Hong Kong to his/her* place of origin.
